MacinRender Rust EAR subset

Derived from EBU libear, commit 2db69f8fcea0bc5db8a78e14a9c2ae6ed4283c15.
https://github.com/ebu/libear
Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (see LICENSE).
The algorithms were translated and adapted to Rust, with project-owned FFI and tests.
Elementary functions outside the HOA decoder use the pure-Rust libm port instead of the
platform C library, so the gains do not depend on the host (PCM consistency 3.2).
Upstream source fingerprints are recorded in PROVENANCE.json.

The spherical t-design data retains its original bytes and source attribution in
assets/README.md (M. Graf and D. Potts, 2011; University of Vienna point sets).
